children: BridgeBio announced a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government to expand Medicaid access to its marketed medicine Attruby and to lower drug costs while maintaining its Medicare Part D pricing stance.
Entered a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government to expand access and lower costs for patients, per press release.
Will expand state Medicaid access to Attruby via the GENEROUS Model, aimed at improving patient access.
Does not expect to be subject to future pricing mandates and will continue offering Attruby via Medicare Part D.
Agreement excludes medicines approved exclusively for orphan indications from the Company’s pricing commitment.
ForgingBridges patient support program remains unaffected, continuing to offer reimbursement help and potential $0 monthly out-of-pocket costs for qualifying patients.
